format: bash script with embedded C code
description: A shell script containing test functions that generate C source code snippets, perform diff operations between them, and validate the changes. The script includes embedded C code for functions like frobnitz, fact, and fib, and scripts for diff comparison and testing diff attributes.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Main test function that creates two C source snippets, diffs them, and compares the output against expected results. It tests diffing with different functions, attributes, and configurations.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Test function that diffs two completely different text files and checks the diff output.
